title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29
lineage: Transfer: Cassette > Tascam 122 MK3 > Korg MR2000S > DFF @5.6 MHz > Audiogate > wav 24/96. Lineage: wav 24/96 > iZotope RX8 Advanced > wav 16/44.1 > CD Wave > Flac 16
taper: This is Mark Cohen’s tape (Judy Lee’s brother) who worked for Electra records. It was given to Mark by Hail Milgraham, who was a colleague at Electra.

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a rare three‑set 1966 show, highlighted by classic Me & My Uncle, The Same Thing and a slew of ultra‑rare cuts.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard source that, despite needing a slight pitch tweak and channel swap, delivers clear audio of one of ’66’s most coveted performances. Reviewers rave about the abundance of rarities—Me & My Uncle, The Same Thing, Stealin', One Kind Favor, Early Morning Rain, Cold Rain & Snow, Down So Long, There's Something on Your Mind and I Just Want to Make Love to You—making it a must‑listen for collectors. Jerry’s cold is noted, but the band still pushes through with strong playing throughout all three sets.

ai_rating.rationale: The show is praised for its rare material and overall performance (70% weight), while the recording is deemed good despite minor pitch/channel issues (30% weight).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard capture but runs slightly slow; requires ~+1 % pitch correction and channel swap for optimal listening.

standout_songs: I Just Want to Make Love to You
show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon with a strong second set of rarities and an eclectic third set; the pacing keeps interest high despite missing the first set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned having a cold and handing vocal duties to Phil; also noted for rare original 'Down So Long'.
band_member_comments.Phil: Was asked by Jerry to sing on some numbers.
